questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. a. This results in 32% of global food production being discarded. b. In a world where more than 700 million people suffer from hunger, this scale of waste is unacceptable. c. Food loss and waste represent one of the most pressing challenges to sustainable global food systems. d. According to the estimates of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP), 13% of food produced globally is lost before it reaches the retail stage, while an additional 19% is wasted at the retail, food service, and household levels.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

a. This results in 32% of global food production being discarded.

b. In a world where more than 700 million people suffer from hunger, this scale of waste is unacceptable.

c. Food loss and waste represent one of the most pressing challenges to sustainable global food systems.

d. According to the estimates of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP), 13% of food produced globally is lost before it reaches the retail stage, while an additional 19% is wasted at the retail, food service, and household levels.

options.html: d, b, a, c
c, a, b, d
a, b, c, d
c, d, a, b

questions.solution: c: Paragraph की शुरुआत sentence c से होती है, क्योंकि यह विषय को प्रस्तुत करता है और बताता है कि food loss और waste वैश्विक खाद्य प्रणालियों (global food systems) के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण चुनौती है। यह पूरी discussion के लिए context सेट करता है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The teacher emphasised the importance of ___________ correct grammar and punctuation in our writing.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The teacher emphasised the importance of ___________ correct grammar and punctuation in our writing.
questions.solution: 'Using' is correct because it functions as a present participle here, completing the noun phrase following "the importance of." 'Used' is past tense, meaning "something that has been utilized," which doesn't align with the sentence meaning. 'Uses' is for third-person singular, which is not appropriate here. 'Use' as a base form is grammatically incorrect in this structure.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank. The Nile is the _________ river in the world
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.

The Nile is the _________ river in the world
questions.solution: 'Longest' will be used because it means "the most extended in length." The sentence indicates that the Nile is the longest river in the world, making the superlative form appropriate. 'Long' is the base form and simply means "extended in length." 'Longer' is the comparative degree, used when comparing two things. 'Most long' is grammatically incorrect, as "long" uses 'longest' in the superlative degree.

questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The Indian monsoon has been (A) / progressing slow with rainfall 37% (B) / below average since (C) / the start of the season on June 1. (D)

options.html: The Indian monsoon has been
progressing slow with rainfall 37%

options.text: the start of the season on June 1.
options.html: the start of the season on June 1.

questions.solution: 'slowly' will be used instead of 'slow' because 'progressing' is a Verb and an Adverb (slowly) is used to modify a Verb, not an Adjective (slow); Like—The tortoise moves slowly.

questions.solution: 'has helped' will be used instead of 'had helped' because in the Principal Clause the verb 'has ebbed' is in Present Perfect Tense, so in the Relative Clause also the Verb will be in Present Perfect Tense; Like— The rain has stopped, which has brought relief to people.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. P. The serious complaint of human rights violation recently against an IPS officer in Ambasamudram in south Tamil Nadu should greatly embarrass the State government and the police hierarchy. Q. The officer has been suspended from service and his alleged misconduct is being probed. R. This should send a strong message to the police force in the State that no illegal physical treatment of crime suspects will be tolerated and that such behaviour will be subjected to a clinical and credible enquiry by an independent authority. S. The Chief Minister must be complimented for his swift action against the offending official.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

P. The serious complaint of human rights violation recently against an IPS officer in Ambasamudram in south Tamil Nadu should greatly embarrass the State government and the police hierarchy.

Q. The officer has been suspended from service and his alleged misconduct is being probed.

R. This should send a strong message to the police force in the State that no illegal physical treatment of crime suspects will be tolerated and that such behaviour will be subjected to a clinical and credible enquiry by an independent authority.

S. The Chief Minister must be complimented for his swift action against the offending official.
questions.solution: P: This sentence introduces an incident of human rights violation against an IPS officer. It is an introductory sentence that sets the context for the rest of the paragraph. Hence, P should come first
